entries.text: You’ve found all the Sunflora in town! Time to\nbring them to the Sunflora Lawn.

entries.text: Congratulations on defeating the Artazon Gym!\nI must say, the Gym Badge suits you very well.
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_01

entries.text: You sure did a great job finding the Sunflora\naround town during your Gym Test.
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_03

entries.text: And it’s not just me who thinks that—the Sunflora\nwere very impressed as well!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_04

entries.text: So would you like to join us a little longer for\nanother game of Sunflora Hide-and-Seek?
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_05

entries.text: Sunflo-radical! Now the Sunflora will have even\nmore reason to smile nice and bright!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_06

entries.text: I’ll go ahead and ask them to spread themselves\nout around town!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_07

entries.text: OK! The Sunflora say they’re all ready for you!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_09

entries.text: There are [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora left to find in town.

entries.text: There’s just one Sunflora left to find!

entries.text:
The more Sunflora you find, the more prizes
you’ll get from me for your hard work.\c
To receive your first prize...please find [VAR 0x0201(0001)]
Sunflora and bring [VAR 0x1101(0001,0402)]itthem back here!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_11

entries.text: Oh, OK! Let me know if you change your mind.

entries.text: Hello again, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0302)]r.iss Gym Challenger! Feel like\nanother game of Sunflora Hide-and-Seek?

entries.text: Looks like you’ve found [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora so far!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_15

entries.text: That means there are still [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora left to\nfind around town.

entries.text: Find [VAR 0x0201(0001)] more and I’ll give you a nice prize.\nHave fun!

entries.text:
Gosh, you’ve sure found lots of Sunflora!
Well done!\c
Since you’ve found at least [VAR 0x0201(0001)] of them now,
you can have this nice prize!

entries.text: I’ll give you a nice prize if you manage to track\ndown even more Sunflora! Your next target is to\r\nreach [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora in total. Good luck!

entries.text: If you manage to find every last Sunflora, I’ll give\nyou a really special prize!\c\nDon’t give up! I know you can find them all!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_23

entries.text: Let’s see... It looks like you’ve managed to find...\nWow! [VAR 0x0201(0001)] Sunflora in total!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_24

entries.text:
That means you found each and every Sunflora
in town! Well done, you!\c
Now for the super-special prize I promised...
Here it is! Go on—you’ve earned it!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_25

entries.text: Thanks so much for playing with the Sunflora.\nI’ve never seen them smile so brightly!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_27

entries.text: You were so absorbed in searching high and low\nfor them all... It was honestly rather touching.\r\nWe’re so glad you played till the very end!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_28

entries.text: Wow, you sure found a lot of Sunflora since we\nlast spoke! Here’s a bunch of prizes from me!
entries.label: sub_001_keeper_29

entries.text:
Oh! You went and found every single Sunflora
since we last spoke!\c
An expert Sunflora seeker like you deserves
some super-special prizes...so here you go!
